title: NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. translated_title: NI-ACT：面向脑具身操作的神经意图接口
translated_abstract: 皮质内脑机接口可以驱动机器人手臂，但用户始终被困在快速的感觉运动回路中：每一次接近、修正和抓取都必须通过神经信号逐步指定。皮质内群体神经活动能否转而作为学习到的具身策略的任务级条件——无需符号命令或手工设计的技能库——仍是一个未知问题。NI-ACT通过一个分层的脑-具身框架回答了这一问题：一次性读取短暂的运动皮层信号作为持久意图，随后由视觉运动策略基于视觉和本体感觉闭合感知-行动回路。在一个场景本身无法指定目标的反事实抓取任务中，仅凭神经意图就决定了机器人抓取哪个物体；替换意图则会相应地改变行为。将完整的群体神经潜变量作为专用意图token传递，而非单热解码的方向，提升了抓取完成率……
tldr: NI-ACT提出了一种分层脑-具身操作框架，将短暂读取的运动皮层群体神经活动编码为持久意图token来条件化视觉运动策略，使神经意图本身即可决定机器人抓取的目标，从而让用户摆脱传统脑机接口中需逐动作神经指定的快速感觉运动回路。
en_tdlr: NI-ACT introduces a hierarchical brain-embodied framework that reads a brief motor-cortical population signal once as a persistent intent token to condition a visuomotor policy, allowing the neural intent itself—rather than step-by-step neural specification—to determine which object the robot grasps, freeing users from the fast sensorimotor loop of conventional intracortical BCIs.
